# Windrose at Caledon Trails
> Independent information page for a new-home opportunity associated with the Caledon Trails community in Caledon, Ontario.

- Official community location: Mayfield Drive and McLaughlin Road, Caledon
- Broader-community builders named by caledontrails.ca: Laurier Homes and Yorkwood Homes
- Windrose-specific prices, floor plans, deposits, incentives, launch date and occupancy: to be announced as of 14 August 2026
- This website is independent and is not the official builder site

Primary source: https://caledontrails.ca/
Canonical: https://windrosecaledontrails.ca/
